candidates.title: LiquidGEMM: Hardware-Efficient W4A8 GEMM Kernel for High-Performance LLM Serving
candidates.reason: Concrete GPU-kernel systems work for quantized LLM serving, with hardware-efficient dequantization and warp-group pipeline design plus kernel and end-to-end TensorRT-LLM comparisons.

candidates.title: FineServe: Precision-Aware KV Slab and Two-Level Scheduling for Heterogeneous Precision LLM Serving
candidates.reason: Serving-system contribution for mixed-precision models combining precision-aware KV memory allocation with global/local scheduling. It directly addresses fragmentation/resource heterogeneity and reports SLO and throughput improvements.

discovery_stats.axis: quantized inference kernels / precision-aware KV memory and scheduling
discovery_stats.query_summary: Moved from thermal scheduling to GPU kernel and quantized-serving systems. LLM Inference in a Flash was already found in the prior run. LiquidGEMM and FineServe were not found by repository code search and provide concrete runtime/system mechanisms.
